```plato
    // The midpoint of an undirected edge.
    EdgeMidpoint(self: TriangleMesh3D, topology: TriangleMeshTopology, edge: UndirectedEdgeIndex): Point3D
    {
        var pair = topology.UndirectedEdges[edge.Value];
        return self.Positions[pair.A.Value].Lerp(self.Positions[pair.B.Value], 0.5);
    }
```
